description:
Search the UI reference catalog by keyword across titles, notes, page sections, and observed
actions. Filter by product or kind (flow/marketing/product).

Use this to find design pattern examples like "pricing page", "empty state", "date picker",
"onboarding step", "checkout form", "dashboard", "sign-up", "settings", etc. Returns the
best matches with screen IDs you can pass to getScreen or getScreenImage.

kind.description: Only return this kind of screen.

product.description: Only return screens from this product id, e.g. linear, stripe, airbnb.

q.description: Keywords to match, e.g. "pricing page", "empty state", "onboarding". Omit to list everything that matches the filters.

name: search_screens

kind.description: flow is an onboarding step, marketing a public web page, product an in-app screen.

previewUrl.description: Screen-sized preview (the top of long pages). Present on pick options.

title: Search screens
